lore: Some say the dead keep a ledger. This shrine is where it is kept, and its soul flame never forgets a name.
use: Open it to see what your deaths cost you. Items still lying in the world stay dim; those that despawned, burned, blew up or fell into the void can be bought back. Every 4 diamonds return one random lost item, at most 3 per offering.
secret: Newer deaths and more valuable items come back more often. Whatever anyone picked up is struck from the ledger, and Soulbound items never appear in it: they never left you.
